name: Valley of Bones
summary: Warug sends you toward Orgrul, a centaur near the Valley of Bones south of Magram Village. The Magram’s discovery is at stake, and Warug says Orgrul will decide whether you learn of it.

sections.title: Warug’s Direction
sections.body: Warug sends you to the far end of Magram Village, where you are to seek Orgrul. He describes Orgrul as a large, foul-smelling centaur near the Valley of Bones, south of the village. You need the Magram to trust you before you can learn of their discovery.

faq.q: Who is asking me to find Orgrul?
faq.answer: Warug asks you to seek Orgrul, a centaur near the Valley of Bones south of Magram Village.
Orgrul is near the Valley of Bones south of Magram Village.

faq.q: What does Warug want me to learn?
faq.answer: Warug says the Magram have made a great discovery, but Orgrul will decide whether you learn what it is.

faq.q: Why do I need the Magram to trust me?
faq.answer: Warug says you need to earn the Magram’s regard before you can learn about their discovery.

faq.q: What happens if Orgrul refuses to tell me?
faq.answer: Warug says you can take comfort in knowing he has a new crown.
